summary: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid in three equal installments.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year transferred directly to bank accounts in three four-monthly installments of Rs 2,000 each.
eligibility: Landholding farmer family (subject to exclusion criteria for high-income/institutional categories)
Valid land records in the farmer's name
application_steps: Register via Common Service Centre or the PM-KISAN portal
Submit land record and bank details for verification
